## Use of colour (WCAG 1.4.1)

Status/semantic colours must never be the **only** channel that conveys meaning: pair each with an icon, text label, or pattern:

- `{color.semantic.status-error}`: pair with an error icon + message
- `{color.semantic.status-success}`: pair with a success icon + message

## Translucent surfaces (Apple Liquid Glass / any blur)

Any translucent or dynamically-tinted surface (Liquid Glass, glassmorphism, blur overlays) is a documented contrast-failure risk: verify the effective foreground/background contrast **over the actual content behind it**, in every theme, and record the worst-case pair here.
